messages: #p218# over at #m10001050# seems to be mulling over what she'd like for her birthday present.

I met #b#p218##k at #m10001050#, and with a mischievous look on her face, she said what she'd really like as a birthday present is a #b#t4031008##k. The trouble is, that's the very same precious item #p204# once gave to #p225# as a birthday present... I'd better head back to #b#p204##k first. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
#p204# was taken aback to hear what #p218# wants for her birthday.
name: Pia's Mischievous Wish
